invariants.title: An issued invoice is immutable — mistakes are void-and-reissue, on the record.
The seller and bill-to blocks freeze at issuance; issuing without a profile or a client address is refused with the guide sentence.
Numbers are sequential and never reused; a voided number stays burned.
Invoice timing is the freelancer's agreement — the system records, never gatekeeps terms.
No invented facts: amounts, dates and names come from the person or stay empty.
Documents are produced, never sent; the doc link views one document (DRAFT-stamped until issued) and nothing more.
Every write is a logged act with an actor; refusals are logged too.
Journal derivation balances: issue to AR/Revenue, receipt to Cash/Deposits, application to Deposits/AR.
An invoice carries exactly one currency from the company's set, a payment too; cash never crosses currencies; sums are per currency.
Tax follows the company's scheme, frozen at issue: unregistered lines cannot carry tax; registered lines default to the rate and the document prints TAX INVOICE.
Numbers follow the company's format (sequence token, optional year token) and stay sequential and never reused within it.
